title: PriceFlow
summary: Real-time pricing service with Python ETL pipelines feeding analytics into BigQuery.
description: Built Python ETL pipelines using Pandas, PyArrow and Apache Spark to process transactional data, store it as columnar Parquet, and load analytical datasets into Google BigQuery.
Developed the real-time pricing service in Java Spring Boot, automating price optimisation based on inventory, demand and competitor pricing, using Apache Kafka and Redis.
Implemented price-prediction models with Scikit-learn and XGBoost, with the stack containerised using Docker over MySQL.

title: PRISM
tagline: AI Fraud Detection for Privileged-User Risk Monitoring
summary: Real-time insider-threat detection combining a graph neural network with a stacking ensemble.
description: Engineered a real-time insider-threat detection platform combining a HeteroSAGE Graph Neural Network with a stacking ensemble (XGBoost, LightGBM, Isolation Forest) to score privileged-user risk while suppressing false positives.

Added SHAP-based explainability for interpretable, auditable risk scoring, and designed a Dempster–Shafer evidence fusion engine to reconcile independent model predictions and route conflicting evidence to human review.
Served the models through FastAPI on Google Cloud Run over MongoDB and Neo4j, with a Next.js/TypeScript monitoring interface.

title: Raseed
tagline: Agentic Receipt Management for Google Wallet
summary: Multi-agent system turning voice, image and video receipts into structured, queryable records.
description: Built a multi-agent system on Google ADK and Vertex AI that processes voice, image and video receipts into structured records for natural-language querying, and generated dynamic Google Wallet passes with receipt metadata and aggregated spending summaries on Firestore and Cloud Functions.
